[[File:Giant_Model_Gong.png|thumb|right|250px|A gong]]
A '''gong''' was a musical instrument. When struck with the appropriate force, the gong produced a loud, resonating tone. In [[Rise of the Empire era|the years preceding the rise]] of [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] kept a gong in [[Jedi Temple/Legends|their temple]]. It was used to signal time, being struck at the top of every hour.

[[Dinner gong]]s, a specific type of gongs, were used to signal the readiness of [[nightmeal]], particularly among [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]].

[[Smuggler's Rest (Ruusan)|Smuggler's Rest]] had a drink gong that sounded whenever bought a round of [[alcohol/Legends|drinks]].<ref name="Dark Forces: Jedi Knight">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>
